title: A credential sealed into one context on one machine, fabric-credential-envelope/1 (DEC-0111)
description: HPKE (RFC 9180) base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], to the target's #kem, info the ASCII fabric-credential-envelope/1, the RFC 8785 bytes of the header the additional data; signed over the RFC 8785 bytes of {header, ct}: in an organization's context by a key of its current policy key set (EdDSA), in the personal context by the sending machine's #sig (ES256). An organization's envelope answers a credential-request/1 and ends at credentialExpiresAt. FAC-SEM-139: the target's answer is checkCredentialEnvelope's. docs/specification/credentials.md#the-envelope.

alg.description: EdDSA in an organization's context (a key of its policy key set), ES256 in the personal context (the sending machine's #sig); another is unsupported-alg

recipient.description: the target machine's key-agreement key id

signer.description: the organization's policy keyId, or the sending machine's #sig kid

slot.description: the credential's slot name, never its value

provider.description: the provider the credential is for, e.g. cloudflare or openrouter

requestId.description: the credential-request/1 this answers; present exactly in an organization's context

credentialExpiresAt.description: when the credential ends and the target deletes it; present exactly in an organization's context, at most 30 days after iat

sequence.description: the sealer's sequence for (context, agentRef, slot)

enc.description: the HPKE encapsulated key, an uncompressed P-256 point, base64url

sig.description: 64 bytes, base64url: Ed25519, or ES256 as R ‖ S, low-S
